name: Włodawa (Poland)
description: Green hoist panel charged with crossed yellow torch and swords from the Jelita arms, and a white fly panel with two green triangles pointing to the hoist.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: crossed torch and swords from the city arms
two triangles pointing to the hoist
